text.p: Polish computer maker Optimus SA surged 9.7 percent to 96.5 zlotys and analysts said the stock was benefiting from strong 1996 earnings, which the firm said it might repeat this year.
Demand for the stock after price-fixing was strong enough for players to have their bids reduced.
"Optimus' rises confirm that the market is reacting euphorically to any good news," one trader said.
Optimus has jumped 125 percent since December 10. Since then the main market has risen 27 percent.

Analysts said Optimus had also been helped by its gaining of a dividend from a subsidiary, and the news it would seek a strategic investor after completing its convertible bond programme, which was running smoothly.
